bullets.text: Highlight Reels for Xbox Insiders - **Xbox** Insiders can now create highlight reels via the Xbox PC app.
JavaScript AI Build-a-thon Launches - A hands-on program to integrate **AI** into JavaScript applications kicks off today.
GitHub Copilot Dev Days Announced - A series of events to enhance developer productivity with **GitHub Copilot** begins soon.
OAuth Abuse Threats Identified - **Microsoft** warns of phishing attacks exploiting OAuth redirection mechanisms.
Sovereign Cloud Enhancements - **Microsoft** Sovereign Cloud now supports large **AI** models in disconnected environments.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New features and improvements are rolling out in the latest **Windows 11** builds.
Microsoft and OpenAI Partnership Continues - **Microsoft** reaffirms its strong collaboration with **OpenAI** amid new developments.
New Cloud PC Devices Unveiled - **Microsoft** announces new devices designed for seamless **Windows 365** integration.
Threat Modeling for AI Applications - **Microsoft** emphasizes the need for updated threat modeling in AI systems.
Scaling Security Operations with Microsoft Defender - **Microsoft Defender** introduces autonomous defense strategies for modern threats.
